name: buchcraft
description: buchcraft L3: native egui desktop app calling the L1 command bus in-process.

tools.name: buch_status
tools.description: Ledger status: counts, open drafts, unmatched bank lines, closed periods, demo flag.

tools.name: buch_accounts_list
tools.description: List the chart of accounts (EKR).

tools.name: buch_accounts_seed
tools.description: Insert the EKR seed chart (existing numbers untouched).

tools.name: buch_account_add
tools.description: Add an account.

tools.name: buch_entry_book
tools.description: Book a balanced journal entry. Net lines carry a tax_key; the engine generates the tax lines. Lines (incl. generated tax) must sum to zero.

tools.name: buch_entry_book_gross
tools.description: Book a gross amount in one step: account gets net, engine adds tax, contra gets -gross.

tools.name: buch_entry_reverse
tools.description: Storno an entry (the only way to correct a booking).

tools.name: buch_entry_show
tools.description: Show one entry with its lines.

tools.name: buch_journal
tools.description: Journal for a date range, optionally one Belegkreis.

tools.name: buch_balance
tools.description: Saldenliste (debit, credit, balance per account) for a date range.

tools.name: buch_account_ledger
tools.description: Kontoblatt with opening and running balance.

tools.name: buch_u30
tools.description: U30 VAT pre-fill (Kennzahlen 000/006/022/029/060/065/070/072/095) for a month YYYY-MM. Not a filing.

tools.name: buch_period_close
tools.description: Close a month (YYYY-MM); later bookings dated in it are refused.

tools.name: buch_bank_import
tools.description: Import a bank statement CSV (German or English headers). Re-importing the same file adds nothing. Needs --allow-path.

tools.name: buch_bank_unmatched
tools.description: Bank lines not yet booked.

tools.name: buch_bank_book
tools.description: Book an unmatched bank line against an account (gross; tax key splits it) and link it.

tools.name: buch_drafts
tools.description: Drafts created from other apps' events (open only unless all=true).

tools.name: buch_draft_approve
tools.description: Book a draft.

tools.name: buch_draft_discard
tools.description: Discard a draft.

tools.name: buch_inbox_drain
tools.description: Read events from other craft apps (e.g. assetcraft depreciation) and turn them into drafts.

tools.name: buch_export_csv
tools.description: Export journal lines as semicolon CSV (DE format). Needs --allow-path.

tools.name: buch_demo_seed
tools.description: Fill an EMPTY ledger with a labelled demo company (October 2026).
